front: Rule: What are the 7 basic Roman symbols?
note: Learn the seven symbols before combining them.

front: Rule: When do you add symbol values?
back: When a symbol is followed by one of equal or smaller value.

front: Rule: When do you subtract symbol values?
back: When a permitted smaller symbol appears immediately before a larger one.

front: Rule: Which subtractive pairs are standard?
back: IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM.
note: I may precede V or X; X may precede L or C; C may precede D or M.

front: Rule: How many times can I, X, C and M repeat?
back: Up to three consecutive times in standard notation.

front: Rule: Can V, L and D repeat?
back: No. V, L and D are not repeated in standard notation.
note: 10 is X, not VV; 100 is C, not LL.

front: Rule: Does classical Roman numeral notation have a symbol for zero?
note: Standard Roman numerals represent positive integers.
